Located in the [[Orus sector/Legends|Orus sector]], the '''Chazwa system''' contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chazwa/Legends|Chazwa]]. Its [[Chazwa (star)|sun]] was a [[White dwarf/Legends|white dwarf]] type [[Star/Legends|star]].

==History==
The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located along a popular [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] traffic route. As such, heavy freight traffic within the system was not an uncommon sight. However, the abundance of valuable merchandise moving through the system lent itself to a strong influence by [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].

During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the ''[[Kern's Pride]]'' was [[Skirmish at Chazwa|pursued]] by a pair of [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigates]] in the system, but he managed to escape with the assistance of [[Talon Karrde]] and the ''[[Wild Karrde]]''.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
